text: Nina (Design): dropped a new mock for the notifications panel — includes inline channel preview, reorder affordance, and a pause control. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz987/alerts-panel. would love quick gut-checks on copy and a11y. Arjun (Frontend): skimmed it. layout makes sense. small convo: how should reorder work on mobile? touch handles only, but on desktop we need keyboard support. Marta (A11y): keyboard first: avoid gesture-only patterns. prefer explicit `Move up` / `Move down` buttons (visually small) for assistive tech plus optional drag handle for mouse users. provide `aria-live` updates. Priya (PM): copy decision: current CTA reads `Temporarily silence`. We've historically used `Mute` elsewhere. I'd rather be explicit: `Pause notifications`. Also tooltip should indicate duration, e.g. `Pause notifications for 30 minutes`. Nina (Design): ok will switch to `Pause notifications` in the mock. question: in the compact preview we show `Example: [subject] — first line` 10px. is that too noisy? Arjun (Frontend): compact preview is handy. dev note: we'll lazy-render sample content; avoid heavy parsing for >15 channels. Also, for the preview chevron, we'll render a button with `aria-expanded` to control the flyout. Marta (A11y): on the flyout — treat as a popup (`role="dialog"` if it's modal) and ensure `aria-modal` when trapping focus. If not trapping, use `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`. Make sure escape closes it. Nina (Design): also exploring a tiny inline badge indicating suppression state: `Paused until 11:30 AM` — would that be readable for screen readers? Marta (A11y): keep the visible text, and add `aria-live="polite"` updates for state changes. don't hide the time in an icon-only tooltip. screen readers need explicit text. Priya (PM): one more copy nuance: within channel rows we currently show `Email • Immediate`. proposal: `Email — Deliver: Immediate` so it reads naturally when concatenated for SR. Arjun (Frontend): good idea. we'll also include a visually-hidden `span` with `role="status"` updates on reorder and pause toggles. e.g.: ``` Email moved to position 2 ``` Nina (Design): about reorder visuals 10px gap between rows feels tight, maybe 12-14px. also thinking of a subtle grab handle icon at the left to indicate reorder. Marta (A11y): contrast callout: the pale blue token for `Immediate` only has ~3.8:1 on white. bump to a darker tone or add a 1px stroke to meet 4.5:1. also ensure focus ring is at least 3px and not color-only. Arjun (Frontend): will adjust tokens. for keyboard reorder we can implement roving tabindex + arrow keys with a helper `aria-describedby` pointing at instructions: "Use Alt+Up / Alt+Down to reorder." Priya (PM): regarding suppression preview: when a channel is paused, should the preview still show example payloads? maybe show a dimmed preview with an overlay label `Paused` so customers can still validate format. Marta (A11y): dimmed preview ok but include a `aria-hidden="true"` on the decorative layer and a visible text node announcing `Channel paused` for screen readers. Nina (Design): noted. I'll mock the dimmed state + overlay copy: `Paused — resumes at 11:30 AM`. design-bot: snapshot saved: https://bot.redwood/snapshots/1729003456.png :frame_with_picture: Arjun (Frontend): I'll prototype the keyboard reorder and flyout interactions tomorrow. plan: add tests for NVDA + VoiceOver in CI smoke. Marta (A11y): will run a quick pass on the prototype and post any keyboard/reading-order issues. Priya (PM): awesome. if we can land the copy and a11y updates today, we can ship the change with the next minor release. thanks y'all. :tada:
